axis: Native +X follows Brīvības Boulevard to the northeast. The broad entry and shield-bearing front face toward the southwest, in the direction of the mapped rectangular apron.
visualScope: Freedom Monument in Riga with its circular granite terraces, carved side panels, stone figures, tapered travertine shaft, and copper Liberty holding three gilded stars.
limitations: The map anchors the apron, shaft, curved walls and boulevard axis. Sculpture proportions and most vertical details come from ordinary photographs and the sculpture plan.
The figure poses, carving depths and smaller relief details are exterior reconstructions. The surrounding boulevard, park, canal and buildings remain in the host map.
